data.name: label35.Text
data.value:
Click On The Drop Down Menu, To Sellect A Thermal Camera. Sellecting A New Camera, When Connected, Will Disconnect The Current Camera.
Having Problems Connecting To The Camera?
Make Sure That The Camera Is Connected To The PC And That The Correct Camera Model Has Been Selected In The Drop Down Menu.
Check Your PCs Device Manager For Confirmation That Your Camera Is Probably Connected To Your Computer.
